svg.title: How one write flows through OpenHAL
svg.desc: An MCP client asks to set fan_speed to 150 percent. The device file gives a limit of 100 percent. The safety kernel draws both on its limit-line gauge and blocks the write as above_max. The client then asks for 60 percent, which is within the limit and rate, so the kernel issues a single-use grant. The driver uses the grant to send 60 percent to the device, and the device reports fan_speed 60 percent back.
